title: Anonymous subclasses of abstract classes
answer: You cannot instantiate an abstract class directly, but you can create an anonymous concrete subclass in the same expression and instantiate that subclass. The anonymous body must implement any remaining abstract methods. This is useful for small one-off implementations, although named classes or lambdas are often clearer when reuse or a functional interface applies.
